question: Where can I find a fast food restaurant no more than 100 kilometers away to the southeast of Indian Run Falls Park - Observation Deck B, Dublin, OH?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Indian Run Falls Park - Observation Deck B%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 100000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Indian Run Falls Park - Observation Deck B%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry ) ) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5;
